title: A must have for every kitchen!
text: A must have for every kitchen!. This is just what I was looking for for my kitchen. It is a nice size and clings nicely to my quartz countertop. I can wash loads of dishes and place them to drain on this mat. Water rolls off easily and dishes dry quickly. When I am entertaining I simply roll up the mat and store it. Highly recommend, especially the grey color as it seems to blend with most kitchen decors.
